displayName: User Execution: Malicious Copy and Paste

tests.name: Malicious Copy and Paste through Run.exe
tests.description: This test simulates a ClickFix attack where a user is asked to copy and paste a powershell command into run.exe. The powershell command uses Invoke-Expression to download and execute an obfuscated powershell file. Upon execution, a powershell window will open and display "Hello World!" for 30 seconds before closing.
